lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸਰਬਾਂਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan manamohan laalan sukhadaaee sarabaa(n)gai ||
lines.translation: The Treasure of Virtue, the Enticer of the mind, my Beloved is the Giver of peace to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak prabh paahi pathaaio milahu sakhaa gal laagai ||2||5||28||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak has led me to You, O God. Join with me, O my Best Friend, and hold me close in Your Embrace. ||2||5||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab moro thaakur siu man maanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Now my mind is pleased and appeased by my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਛੇਦਿਓ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh kripaal daiaal bhae hai ihu chhedio dusat bigaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Holy Saint has become kind and compassionate to me, and has destroyed this demon of duality. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁਘਰ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum hee su(n)dar tumahi siaane tum hee sughar sujaanaa ||
lines.translation: You are so beautiful, and You are so wise; You are elegant and all-knowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sagal jog ar giaan dhiaan ik nimakh na keemat jaanaa(n) ||1||
lines.translation: All the Yogis, spiritual teachers and meditators do not know even a bit of Your value. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਨਾਇਕ ਤੁਮੑਹਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum hee naaik tumhhi chhatrapat tum poor rahe bhagavaanaa ||
lines.translation: You are the Master, You are the Lord under the royal canopy; You are the perfectly pervading Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: paavau daan sa(n)t sevaa har naanak sad kurabaanaa(n) ||2||6||29||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the gift of service to the Saints; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||6||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man cheet aae pri ra(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: The Love of my Beloved comes into my conscious mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਰਜਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisario dha(n)dh ba(n)dh maaiaa ko rajan sabaaee ja(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have forgotten the entangling affairs of Maya, and I spend my life-night fighting with evil. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sevau har ridai basaavau har paaiaa satasa(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: I serve the Lord; the Lord abides within my heart. I have found my Lord in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aiso milio manohar preetam sukh paae mukh ma(n)gaa ||1||
lines.translation: So I have met with my enticingly beautiful Beloved; I have obtained the peace which I asked for. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਭੋਗਉ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: priu apanaa gur bas kar deenaa bhogau bhog nisa(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has brought my Beloved under my control, and I enjoy Him with unrestrained pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਠੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae naanak bhau mitiaa har paaio paatha(n)gaa ||2||7||30||
lines.translation: I have become fearless; O Nanak, my fears have been eradicated. Chanting the Word, I have found the Lord. ||2||7||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu ke darasan kau kurabaanee ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Dear Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਨਾਦ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੇਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bachan naad mere sravanahu poore dehaa pri a(n)k samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Naad, the Sound-current of His Word fills my ears; my body has settled gently into the Lap of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਰਿ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhootar te gur keeee souhaagan har paaio sughaR sujaanee ||
lines.translation: I was a discarded bride, and the Guru has made me a happy soul-bride. I have found the Elegant and All-knowing Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਬਾਸਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jih ghar mahi baisan nahee paavat so thaan milio baasaanee ||1||
lines.translation: That home, in which I was not even allowed to sit - I have found that place in which I can dwell. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਆਇਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਆਨ ਸੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: unh kai bas aaio bhagat bachhal jin raakhee aan sa(n)taanee ||
lines.translation: God, the Love of His devotees, has come under the control of those who protect the honor of His Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak har sa(n)g man maaniaa sabh chookee kaan loukaanee ||2||8||31||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, my mid is pleased and appeased with the Lord, and my subservience to other people has come to an end. ||2||8||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mero pa(n)chaa te sa(n)g tootaa ||
lines.translation: Now my association with the five thieves has come to an end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan dekh bhae man aanad gur kirapaa te chhootaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is in ecstasy; by Guru's Grace, I am released. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਖ ਸੂਰੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikham thaan bahut bahu dhareeaa anik raakh soorootaa ||
lines.translation: The impregnable place is guarded by countless ramparts and warriors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ੍ਹ ਕਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਨਥ ਭਏ ਲੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bikham gaarh kar pahuchai naahee sa(n)t saanath bhae lootaa ||1||
lines.translation: This impregnable fortress cannot be touched, but with the assistance of the Saints, I have entered and robbed it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਿਆ ਅਮੋਲ ਲਾਲ ਆਖੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut khajaane merai paalai pariaa amol laal aakhootaa ||
lines.translation: I have found such a great treasure, a priceless, inexhaustible supply of jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਘੂਟਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree tau man mahi har ras ghootaa ||2||9||32||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, when God showered His Mercy on me, my mind drank in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||9||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mero thaakur siu man leenaa ||
lines.translation: Now my mind is absorbed in my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: praan daan gur poorai deeaa urajhaaio jiu jal meenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the breath of life. I am involved with the Lord, like the fish with the water. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਹ ਅਰਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad matasar ih arap sagal daan keenaa ||
lines.translation: I have cast out sexual desire, anger, greed, egotism and envy; I have offered all this as a gift.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)tr driRaai har aukhadh gur deeo tau milio sagal prabeenaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru has implanted the medicine of the Lord's Mantra within me, and I have met with the All-knowing Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਖੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihu teraa too thaakur meraa gur hau khoee prabh deenaa ||
lines.translation: My household belongs to You, O my Lord and Master; the Guru has blessed me with God, and rid me of egotism.
